f.title: Undertake to inform the Minister immediately of new adverse reactions or accidents after authorisation
f.statement: The registration application must be accompanied by a sworn undertaking (engagement sur l'honneur) to inform the Minister of Public Health immediately of the appearance of new adverse (secondary) reactions or accidents linked to the use of the product after the marketing authorisation (AMM) has been obtained.
f.clause: Art. 5(1) - Administrative documents accompanying the registration application
f.applicability: Medicinal products registered and authorised in Cameroon

rows.actor: Applicant for registration (homologation) / marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
l'engagement sur l'honneur :
(a) d'informer immédiatement le Ministre chargé de la santé publique de
l'apparition des réactions secondaires nouvelles ou d'accidents liés à
l'utilisation du produit après l’obtention de l'A.M.M. ;
rows.location: Art. 5(1) - Administrative documents accompanying the registration application
rows.review_note: Review: the duty is framed as a mandatory undertaking ('est accompagné des pièces ... l'engagement') filed with the application, binding after authorisation; level Mandatory. Re-translation agrees ('réactions secondaires nouvelles' = new adverse/secondary reactions). Double-check: no numeric deadline ('immédiatement'), so no deadline_rule; held just below 90 because the obligation is expressed as an undertaking in the dossier rather than a direct reporting article.
rows.quote_en: - the sworn undertaking: (a) to inform the Minister of Public Health immediately of the appearance of new secondary reactions or accidents linked to the use of the product after the M.A. has been obtained;

f.title: Undertake to inform the Minister of later changes in the country of manufacture within one month
f.statement: The registration application must include an undertaking to inform the Minister of Public Health of any subsequent modification made in the country of manufacture, within at most one month of the date of that modification.
f.applicability: Registered medicinal products; modifications made in the country of manufacture

rows.actor: Applicant for registration (homologation) / marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: At most 1 month after the date of the modification
rows.review_note: Review: not specific to safety but kept because it covers changes in the country of origin (which include safety-driven changes) and carries a fixed deadline; Mandatory as an undertaking required by Art. 5. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: scope is broad (any modification); held below 90.
rows.quote_en: (b) to inform him of any subsequent modification undergone in the country of manufacture, within a maximum period of one (1) month following the date of that modification;

deadline_rule.clock_start:
suivant la date de
             cette modification
deadline_rule.applies_to: Any subsequent modification in the country of manufacture

f.title: Undertake to withdraw immediately all products whose authorisation is suspended or expired
f.statement: The registration application must include an undertaking to withdraw immediately from the Cameroonian market all products whose marketing authorisations are suspended or have expired.
f.applicability: Products whose AMM is suspended or expired
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Applicant for registration (homologation) / marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
(c) de retirer immédiatement du marché camerounais la totalité des
produits dont les AMM sont suspendues ou arrivées à expiration ;
rows.review_note: Review: kept as a regulatory-action duty (suspension, often safety-driven). Re-translation agrees; Mandatory. Double-check: below 90 as the duty is framed as an undertaking.
rows.quote_en: (c) to withdraw immediately from the Cameroonian market all the products whose M.A.s are suspended or have expired;

f.title: Submit a new registration application for changes to formula or presentation
f.statement: Any change to the formula or presentation of a medicinal product holding an AMM must be the subject of a new registration application; where the change does not alter absorption, tolerance or stability, the holder may submit only the analytical studies and request exemption from other justifications.
f.exceptions: Changes with no effect on absorption, tolerance or stability: analytical studies only may be submitted (permitted).

rows.quote:
ARTICLE 6.- (1) Toute modification apportée à la formule ou à la présentation d'un
médicament bénéficiant d'une AMM doit faire l'objet d'une nouvelle demande
d'homologation.
(2) Toutefois, s'il apparaît que la nature de la modification n'entraîne
aucun changement dans l'absorption, la tolérance et la stabilité de la spécialité, le
titulaire de l'AMM peut présenter uniquement les études et expertises analytiques
et demander à être dispensé de produire d'autres justifications.
rows.review_note: Review: borderline PV relevance (tolerance criterion); kept as the variation route. 'doit' = Mandatory, 'peut' exception = Permitted, kept together. Double-check: low PV specificity; below 90.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 6.- (1) Any modification made to the formula or presentation of a medicinal product holding an M.A. must be the subject of a new registration application. (2) However, if it appears that the nature of the modification entails no change in the absorption, tolerance and stability of the proprietary product, the M.A. holder may submit only the analytical studies and expert reports and request to be exempted from producing other justifications.

f.title: Submit a clinical dossier when therapeutic indications change
f.statement: Where the therapeutic indications of a medicinal product holding an AMM are modified, the manufacturer is required to submit a clinical dossier to update the authorisation.

rows.quote:
ARTICLE 7.- En cas de modification dans des indications thérapeutiques d'un
médicament bénéficiant d'une AMM, le fabricant est tenu de présenter un dossier
clinique en vue de l'actualisation de ladite autorisation.
rows.review_note: Review: 'est tenu' = Mandatory; re-translation agrees. Double-check: indirect PV relevance (product information update); below 90.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 7.- In case of modification of the therapeutic indications of a medicinal product holding an M.A., the manufacturer is required to submit a clinical dossier with a view to updating that authorisation.

f.title: Attest at renewal that no change has occurred in the supporting data
f.statement: After its initial validity period the AMM may be renewed for five years on the holder's request made at least three months before expiry; renewal is granted only if the manufacturer attests that, to its knowledge, no change has occurred in the elements submitted in support of its application.
f.clause: Art. 30 - Validity and renewal of the AMM

rows.deadline: Renewal request at least 3 months before AMM expiry
rows.quote:
Après ce délai et sur
demande du titulaire présentée au moins trois (3) mois avant l'expiration de l'AMM,
le produit concerné peut bénéficier d'un renouvellement de l'AMM d'une durée de
cinq (5) ans. Ce renouvellement n'est accordé que si le fabricant atteste qu'à sa
connaissance aucune modification n'est intervenue dans les éléments produits à
l'appui de sa demande.
rows.location: Art. 30 - Validity and renewal of the AMM
rows.review_note: Review: kept as the renewal condition that requires the holder to disclose changes; not a core PV duty. No deadline_rule: the 3-month figure is a minimum lead time before an expiry date not stated in the text. Double-check: below 90 for limited PV relevance.
rows.quote_en: After this period and on request of the holder submitted at least three (3) months before the expiry of the M.A., the product concerned may benefit from a renewal of the M.A. for a period of five (5) years. This renewal is granted only if the manufacturer attests that to his knowledge no modification has occurred in the elements produced in support of his application.
